university: The London School of Economics and Political Science (LSE)

programme.notes: No Computer Science bachelor at LSE. Core answers are read from the related BSc Data Science page (deadline, fee, funding) and the university-wide English requirements page, scoped accordingly (owner ruling for UK universities without a CS-specific page).

english.quote: IELTS Academic (International English Language Testing Service) Including online version 7.0 overall and 7.0 in each component
english.notes: University-wide undergraduate standard (one sitting; valid two years before 1 September of entry). TOEFL iBT 100 with 27 Writing, 25 Reading, 24 Listening, 24 Speaking.

gpa.notes: Grade offers, not a GPA (related programme BSc Data Science): A-levels 'A*AA, with an A* in Mathematics'; IB 39 points with 766 at HL; overseas equivalencies by country dropdown (not in the readable text). The page says the standard offers are 'intended only as a guide'.

deadline.notes: Related programme BSc Data Science, key information for 2027/28 (Home and Overseas full-time both open); UCAS deadline.

value.population: Overseas fee status, BSc Data Science (related programme)

tuition.quote: £37,500 Overseas student fee per each year of your programme This is the 2027/28 fee for each year of your programme.
tuition.notes: Fixed for each year of full-time study for new Overseas entrants from 2027/28. Programme-specific: BSc Data Science, not a CS bachelor.

scholarship_exists.quote: For Overseas fee status students, the School provides a range of bursaries and scholarships, including the LSE Access to Education Scholarships, to support your undergraduate study.
scholarship_exists.notes: Funded by philanthropic donations; number, value and eligibility vary each year.
